definitions: To reach a particular place or state, especially unintentionally or after a series of events.
To find oneself in an unexpected situation or place.
To conclude or result in a specific way.
examples: They ended up living in Canada.
He ended up apologizing for his behavior.
The project ended up costing more than expected.
We ended up getting lost in the city.
She ended up becoming a doctor.
pastTenses: ended up (past simple), ended up (past perfect)
